meta.titleResumeBuilder: Free resume builder — no sign-up, ATS-friendly PDF — cv.cm
meta.descResumeBuilder: Free resume builder, no sign-up: add your experience, education and skills, preview it live and save an ATS-friendly PDF. Your draft stays in your browser.

resume-builder.a1: Yes. There is no sign-up, no watermark and no charge to download: the PDF is made by your browser's print dialog.
resume-builder.a2: The ATS layout is one column with standard headings (Summary, Experience, Education, Skills) and real text, which applicant tracking systems read well. Some postings ask for a Word file; follow the posting when they do.
resume-builder.q3: Should I put a photo on my resume?
resume-builder.a3: In the US, the UK and Canada a resume usually has no photo, to keep hiring decisions free of looks, age and similar details. In many countries in Asia and in parts of Europe a photo is still common; use the layout with a photo there.
resume-builder.a4: Only in this browser's local storage on your device. Nothing is uploaded. Use Save JSON to keep a copy or move it to another computer, and Open JSON to load it.
resume-builder.q5: How long should a resume be?
resume-builder.a5: One page is the usual advice for early and mid career, and two pages for long careers. Keep the most relevant jobs and one line per achievement, with numbers where you can.

resume-builder.lead: Make your resume in three steps.
resume-builder.s1b: ATS layout without a photo for most jobs in the US, UK and Canada, or the layout with a photo where one is expected.
resume-builder.s2b: Replace the example with your contact details, jobs (one achievement per line), education, skills and certifications.
resume-builder.s3b: Press Print / Save as PDF and choose “Save as PDF” as the printer. Save the JSON file too if you want to edit it later on another device.
